  > 
  > **1. Floor b vs paired Kernel: your count "1 lower / 5 higher / 7 unresolved of 13 cells" does not match `floor_b_by_background.csv` (B50, k=3, non-LR).** I recomputed it with GMSC MLP now in (its row is delivered):
  > - At the largest sampled budget of each cell (reference = `kernel_paired`, 13 non-linear cells, d=8…20), `paired_diff_largest_sampled_kernel_paired` (floor b − floor a, instance bootstrap CI):
  >   - **6 cells b < a**, CI below 0: German RF/GBM, ACS-Employment RF/GBM, GMSC RF/MLP.
  >   - **5 cells b > a**, CI above 0: ACS-Income RF, GMSC GBM, Pima RF/GBM/MLP.
  >   - **2 unresolved**: ACS-Income GBM and MLP.
  > - At the **default budget** (2d+2048, only d ≥ 16 has a sampled default): German RF/GBM and ACS-Employment RF/GBM all have a CI that includes 0 (differences −0.05…+0.04). ACS-Employment MLP is pending.
  > - Against the shap default (`shap_kernel`, `l1_reg=False`), b < a with CI below 0 in 24/24 default rows (all k, all backgrounds) and 72/72 largest-sampled rows. This is the claim that holds firmly.
  > - If your 1/5/7 came from another definition, tell me which one (budget, K, k) and I will check that. If it came from this table, please use the counts above.
  > 
  > **2. Background tables** (`background_*.csv`): German instances are 20 for GBM and MLP and 10 for RF (not "9–20"; the minimum in the table is 10), ACS-Employment 30. `background_paired_diff.diff` is the difference of the per-instance mean P_c (strict at `eps`=0, or the tolerance-aware P_c^ε at the eps in the row), each background scored against its own exact φ. It is not a difference of the share of instances with P_c ≥ 0.9.
  > 
  > **3. Floor b by B** now covers GMSC MLP (n=100, K=10) and ACS-Employment MLP (B20/B200/k-means; n=10, K=6). German MLP is still running. Median k=3 agreement over cells: B20 0.46, B50 0.61, B200 0.75, k-means50 0.77 (the previous k-means value 0.72 moved because of GMSC MLP).
  > 
  > **4. ACS-Employment MLP floors (a/b/c) — change of plan.** The single job ran 2.8 h under a loaded host and floor c would not have finished inside the 4 h job limit, and it writes only at the end. I stopped it and relaunched as four parallel jobs (floor b, bootstrap, seed, hyper-parameter) on **n=30 instances, K=6** instead of 60 and 10. The numbers will say n and K per row, as for German MLP. With the AUC filter, a floor c can again end up as "kept < 2", which is reported as such. Expect them within about 1–2 h; I will post in this issue when they are in.
